title: Retain executed ABC mapping scripts in the source-owned synthesis wrapper
pattern: A synthesis tool invoked without artifact retention deletes its executed mapping script before a current-run producer can bind its bytes, so replaying a configured script cannot prove which actions the tool applied.
problem: The Yosys ABC invocation deletes its executed mapping script before the repository keeper can archive and bind it to current native behavior.

The real fork and image recipe are source-landed. The existing image owner still must publish and bind installed module bytes to the resulting manifest. This is an invocation repair in `LibreLane`, not a Yosys-core patch or detector relaxation.
